L1 `import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, type ReactNode } from 'react'`: preserved verbatim (all RN-compatible) — useState backs the `visible` state, useEffect mirrors the IntersectionObserver effect, useCallback backs handleScrollTop, ReactNode types `children`.

L2 `import { ArrowUp } from 'lucide-react'`: lucide is DOM/SVG-only (contract rule 4). Replaced by a bare muted `\u2191` AppText glyph (caption ~ h-3.5, tone muted ~ var(--text-muted)); no icon box so it reads as the same small trailing arrow.
L3 `import { cn } from '@/lib/cn'`: clsx+tailwind-merge class merging has no role in RN; replaced by StyleSheet style arrays. The `className` prop it merged becomes the native `style` prop.
L4 blank line: preserved as import/section spacing; native additionally imports react-native primitives (Pressable, StyleSheet, View, StyleProp, ViewStyle) + AppText + theme tokens (colors, spacing).

L5-12 `targetId: string` prop + its JSDoc (id of the element whose visibility controls the bar): preserved as the `targetId: string` prop. Native has no `document.getElementById`, so it is retained for parity/labelling and kept in the visibility effect's dependency list; the actual visibility boolean is host-supplied via `scrolledPast` (documented on the prop).
L13-14 `children: ReactNode` prop + JSDoc (compressed summary): preserved verbatim as `children: ReactNode`, rendered inside the summary AppText.

L15-20 `scrollToTop?: boolean` prop + JSDoc (whole bar becomes scroll-to-top with `\u2191`): preserved as `scrollToTop?: boolean` (default true at L52 destructure); when true the bar renders as a Pressable + trailing arrow.

L21-22 `topOffset?: number` prop + JSDoc (pixel offset from top, default 0): preserved as `topOffset?: number` (default 0); applied as the bar's `top` and kept in the visibility effect deps (web used it for the observer rootMargin).
L23-26 `ariaLabel: string` prop + JSDoc (aria-label for the sticky region): renamed to the RN convention `accessibilityLabel: string` (required, same intent); used as the region/button label.
L27-28 `testId?: string` prop + JSDoc (test hook on outer node): renamed to the RN convention `testID?: string`; placed on the outer View.

L30 props-interface close `}`: preserved as the close of PageHeaderStickyProps; native added the host-bridge prop `scrolledPast?: boolean` (IntersectionObserver result) and `onScrollToTop?: () => void` (DOM scrollTo replacement), both documented.
L31 blank line: preserved.

L32-48 component JSDoc (IntersectionObserver-driven sticky bar that appears once the hero scrolls out of view, usage example, top rootMargin matching topOffset): preserved + adapted into the file header and the PageHeaderSticky doc comment, documenting the native host bridges (scrolledPast / onScrollToTop) and the unavailable/hidden state.

L49-57 `export function PageHeaderSticky({ targetId, children, scrollToTop = true, topOffset = 0, ariaLabel, testId, className })`: named export + destructure preserved; `ariaLabel`->`accessibilityLabel`, `testId`->`testID`, `className`->`style`, plus the new `scrolledPast`/`onScrollToTop` bridges. Defaults `scrollToTop = true` and `topOffset = 0` kept verbatim.
L58 `const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false)`: preserved verbatim — the visible/hidden state machine is identical.

L60-77 `useEffect` IntersectionObserver (document.getElementById(targetId); observer callback sets visible from `!entry.isIntersecting && entry.boundingClientRect.top < 0`; rootMargin `-topOffset`; observe/disconnect; deps [targetId, topOffset]): the DOM observer is browser-only (contract rule 7). Replaced by an effect that mirrors its role — `setVisible(scrolledPast ?? false)` — where the host scroll container computes that exact boolean and supplies it via `scrolledPast`. `targetId` and `topOffset` are kept in the dependency list to mirror the web effect's deps. The cleanup/disconnect is unnecessary (no observer/subscription to tear down).

L79-91 `handleScrollTop = useCallback(...)` (scroll `#main-content` else `window` to top, smooth; comment about the app's real scroll container): the DOM scroll element + `.scrollTo` are browser-only. Preserved as a useCallback that delegates to the `onScrollToTop` host bridge (the host owns the ScrollView ref); a missing bridge is a no-op, matching the web no-op when scroll position is already 0. The explanatory comment intent is carried over.
L93 `if (!visible) return null`: preserved verbatim (early return as `if (!visible) { return null; }`), placed after all hooks to respect the Rules of Hooks.

The dynamic `top: topOffset` honors the offset prop.

L118 `role="region"`: RN has no 'region' role. The region label is carried by `accessibilityLabel` — on the non-interactive inner View (accessible) or, in the interactive branch, by the Pressable's own label (L127) — avoiding a nested accessible-node conflict.

The `\u2014 scroll to top` suffix is preserved verbatim as in the source; focus-ring/outline -> the pressed surfaceRaised highlight.
